records.title: Report Export
records.purpose: The owner saves the selected data to a file.

records.title: Purpose of the export
records.statement: A fictional teaching example: save a limited report with an explicit outcome of the operation.

records.title: Report screen
records.summary: Accepts the data selection and shows the result of saving.
records.boundary: The internal workings of the screen are out of scope.

records.title: Export
records.summary: Validates whether the report is allowed and saves it.

records.title: Report validation
records.summary: Checks the size of the selected set before writing.
records.boundary: The size-checking algorithm stays inside the component.

records.title: File writing
records.summary: Writes the accepted rows sequentially and returns the result.
records.boundary: A specific file adapter has not been chosen.

records.title: Export request
records.payload: The selected rows and the file destination.
records.meaning: The screen sends a request to validate and save.

records.title: Accepted report
records.payload: The validated set of rows and the file destination.
records.meaning: Writing begins after the validity check.

records.title: Save result
records.payload: Confirmation of saving or the reason for rejection.
records.meaning: The screen shows the actual outcome of the operation.

records.title: Report size limit
records.rule: Export is allowed only within maxRows. If exceeded, the file is not created.

records.title: Allowed size
records.assertion: A set no larger than maxRows is accepted; a larger set is rejected before writing.

records.title: Explicit outcome of the operation
records.rule: The screen shows success only after a successful write; a validation rejection and a write error are distinguishable.
when: The export has finished or was rejected.

records.title: Success and rejection are distinguishable
records.assertion: On a successful write, success is shown; when the limit is exceeded or a write error occurs, the corresponding reason is shown.

records.title: Exclude internal fields
records.rule: Internal fields do not appear in the exported file.

records.title: Sequential writing
records.choice: Validate the set, then write the accepted rows sequentially.
alternatives: Build a second full copy of the report in memory.
records.because: A second full copy of the data for saving is not needed.
consequences: A write error must be returned to the screen.

records.title: Saving and rejection
given: A set of rows is selected.
steps: Check whether the set is allowed.
failures: Exceeding the limit stops the operation before writing.
A write error is returned to the owner with a reason.

records.title: Implement validation and saving
records.change: Connect size validation, sequential writing, and showing the result.

records.title: Export via the user scenario
records.method: Verify the size boundary, rejection before writing, and a write error through a reachable screen path.
